Package com.signalwire.sdk.security

Class WebhookValidator

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.security.WebhookValidator
public final class WebhookValidator extends Object
Webhook signature validation for SignalWire-signed HTTP requests.

Implements both schemes from porting-sdk/webhooks.md:

  • Scheme A (RELAY/SWML/JSON): hex(HMAC-SHA1(key, url + rawBody)).
  • Scheme B (Compat/cXML form): base64(HMAC-SHA1(key, url + sortedFormParams)) with optional bodySHA256 query-param fallback for JSON-on-compat-surface.

All signature comparisons use MessageDigest.isEqual(byte[], byte[]) (constant-time) so the secret cannot be leaked through timing differences.

Public API:

  • validateWebhookSignature(String, String, String, String) — combined entry point.
  • validateRequest(String, String, String, Object) — legacy @signalwire/compatibility-api drop-in alias.

This is a stateless utility — every method is static and the class is not intended to be instantiated.

  • Method Details

    • validateWebhookSignature

      public static boolean validateWebhookSignature(String signingKey, String signature, String url, String rawBody)
      Validate a SignalWire webhook signature against both schemes.

      Tries Scheme A (hex HMAC-SHA1 over url + rawBody) first; on miss, tries Scheme B (base64 HMAC-SHA1 over url + sortedFormParams) with both port-normalization variants of the URL and an optional bodySHA256 fallback for JSON-on-compat-surface.

      Parameters:
      signingKey - customer's Signing Key from the Dashboard. Must be non-null and non-empty; otherwise an IllegalArgumentException is thrown — that's a programming error, not a validation failure.
      signature - the X-SignalWire-Signature header value (or the X-Twilio-Signature alias). null or empty returns false without throwing.
      url - the full URL SignalWire POSTed to (scheme, host, optional port, path, query). Must match what the platform saw — see the URL reconstruction section of porting-sdk/webhooks.md.
      rawBody - the raw UTF-8 request body bytes as a string, before any JSON / form parsing. May be empty but must not be null — pass "" when the body was empty.
      Returns:
      true when the signature matches either scheme, otherwise false.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when signingKey is null or empty, or when rawBody is null.

    • validateRequest

      public static boolean validateRequest(String signingKey, String signature, String url, Object paramsOrRawBody)
      Legacy @signalwire/compatibility-api drop-in entry point.

      Dispatches on the runtime type of paramsOrRawBody:

      • String → delegates to validateWebhookSignature(String, String, String, String).
      • Map or any Iterable of Map.Entry (or 2-element arrays / lists) → treats the value as pre-parsed form params and runs Scheme B directly with URL port normalization.
      • null → treated as an empty params map (Scheme B).
      • Anything else → IllegalArgumentException.
      Parameters:
      signingKey - customer's Signing Key. Non-empty.
      signature - header value. null / empty returns false.
      url - full URL SignalWire POSTed to.
      paramsOrRawBody - String raw body OR pre-parsed form params.
      Returns:
      true on match, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when signingKey is empty or paramsOrRawBody is of an unsupported type.
